# Rock: a jittered icosahedron. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Stone --base-color 0.6706 0.1216 0.3961 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.35 --location 0 0 0.12
scale 1.3 1.0 0.7
apply --scale
material assign Stone
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.06 --seed 3
mode object
shade flat
export rock.glb
